scope: final v6 mallocng source, 24 static/PIC objects from four staged builds, 12 actual archive members, existing eight-mode correctness evidence

check_details.warm_size_domain: All 131052 n values from 0 through MMAP_THRESHOLD-1 model size_to_class to indexes 0..47 and strides >= n+IB. These bounded n cannot overflow n+IB-1 or size_overflows threshold; all other n use unchanged malloc_slow.
check_details.warm_thread_and_actual_lock_guard: Wrapper requires !libc.need_locks and an actual volatile __malloc_lock value of zero. Both positive multithread state and negative final-thread/fork-child transitions fall back. A held or congested lock also falls back. Thread creation publishes need_locks=1 before clone; final-thread exit uses -1; __lock turns -1 into zero while acquiring and existing actual-state unlock releases it.
check_details.warm_avail_consumption_equivalent: ctx.active[sc] must exist. Consuming first=mask&-mask sets avail_mask=mask-first and chooses ctz(first), then calls unchanged enframe with current mmap_counter, matching v5 success with no mapping/sequence/list mutation.
check_details.warm_refill_equivalent: Refill requires avail==0, next==self and freed_mask intersecting the already active range. In unchanged try_avail, both next/fully-free skips stay on the same sole group, the active-range test prevents page activation, then activate_group/assert/decay perform the identical freed-to-avail transfer. Wrapper consumes the same first bit and preserves inactive freed slots. Multi-group traversal, inactive-page growth and misses fall back.
check_details.slow_function_and_helpers_unchanged: malloc_slow body exactly equals v5 malloc body (SHA256 2474b4496970bc03ca18bf13e977a8dca0edf586911808104aa1e9bf9be8a460); alloc_meta, try_avail, alloc_group, alloc_slot, is_allzero identical. noinline prevents the mapping and locking body entering the warm wrapper.
check_details.metadata_all_original_checks_preserved: Retains pointer alignment, large-offset-header zero/>65535 checks, group back-reference, slot last_idx, absent avail/freed bits, secret, ordinary offset lower/upper class bounds, and nonzero mapping-length offset bound before free computes nominal end. free still checks extended reserved encoding/minimum, overflow/redzone zero, nominal bounds, terminator and end byte before header invalidation/publication.
check_details.metadata_integer_promotions_preserved: int sc holds a six-bit sizeclass; int units holds uint16_t class entries, matching the original integer promotion in size_classes[sc]*index and *(index+1). Maximum ordinary product is 8191*32=262112, inside int. size_t maplen on LP64 matches original maplen*4096UL operations. This final source corrects the unsigned/size_t prototype concern.
check_details.direct_class_63_no_out_of_bounds_table_a: The nonordinary branch traps unless sc==63, last_idx==0 and maplen!=0; info stride then uses maplen*4096UL-UNIT. Other callers get the same added validation. No size_classes[63] evaluation is required for validated metadata.
check_details.cached_free_stride_equivalent: For valid ordinary metadata class_stride is UNIT*size_classes[sc]; single-slot mapped groups select actual map stride, all other groups select class_stride. This matches get_stride. index originates from the same header mask. Sole retained ordinary fast-free guard uses cached class_stride and otherwise retains all v5 free/reclamation logic.
check_details.layout_and_public_api_preserved: slot_info is a local return-detail helper, not stored in meta/group/context. No ownership changes or ABI layout changes. get_meta pointer-only wrapper remains for realloc/aligned/is_allzero; realloc, aligned_alloc, calloc and wrappers are byte unchanged from v5. Only two class-63 validation assertions are newly introduced.
check_details.fork_protocol_preserved: Allocator glue byte unchanged within each musl version. fork executes public prepare callbacks before internal allocator locking, resets/unlocks allocator lock before parent/child callbacks; child _Fork and final-thread transitions can leave negative need_locks, which the wrapper excludes. Existing state-based unlock handles a lock acquired during negative-to-zero transition.
check_details.all_24_objects_and_12_archive_members_ve: Re-ran independent objdump/readelf collection against all four canonical manifest cache paths. All final cached patches and staged loaders/archives match exact hashes; all 12 mallocng static members matched one and only one occurrence byte-for-byte in libc.a despite duplicate wrapper basenames.
check_details.slot_info_scalarized_no_added_canary: All eight free objects inline get_meta_with_info, retain index/stride/class_stride in scalar registers and have no helper symbol/call or stack canary reference. x86 free stack adjustment is call alignment only; ARM saves registers and spills one scalar around __lock. All eight realloc objects also have no canary. Warm malloc wrappers have no canary/call, two x86 register pushes with no stack adjustment, zero ARM stack frame, and fallback tail branches. malloc objects retain canaries elsewhere in existing nonleaf code; no claim that entire malloc.o is canary free.
check_details.assert_traps_retained_in_codegen: All 24 objects contain defined ud2 (x86_64) or brk (aarch64) traps. Inspected generated free/realloc metadata and nominal checks, including class63 validation, in static/PIC and both policies; warm wrapper enframe/activation assertions also retain trap branches.
check_details.runtime_evidence_consistent: Rehashed summary/results/logs/input archives, verified embedded actual file hashes and final runtime manifests/static archives. Eight architecture/policy/link-mode combinations each complete original plus supplemental suites: 262816 checks, 32 signalled corruption children, eight exact-zero post-trim map deltas. Each mode has 48-class, refill, thread-transition and public atfork-allocation markers.
